description: This Java class, AuthorizationAdvice, implements a Spring AOP advice that performs authorization checks before service layer methods are invoked. It verifies user privileges, logs relevant information, and throws exceptions if access is not authorized.

classes.name: AuthorizationAdvice
classes.description: A class that implements an AOP advice to perform authorization checks before executing service layer methods.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Method invoked before a service method; performs privilege checks based on annotations and context.

methods.name: throwUnauthorized
methods.description: Overloaded private method that throws an exception when user authorization fails, providing specific debug messages.
